name: ggscatterstats-edge_corr_n4-nonparametric
call: ggstatsplot::ggscatterstats(data = data, x = x, y = y, type = "nonparametric")

analyzed_data.rule: rows with both x and y present, in file order (complete pairs)

subtitle: list(italic("S") == "2.00", italic(p) == "0.20", widehat(rho)["Spearman"] == "0.80", CI["95%"] ~ "[" * "-0.73", "1.00" * "]", italic("n")["pairs"] == "4")

correlation.call: correlation::correlation(data, method = "spearman", ci = 0.95, bayesian = FALSE, bayesian_prior = 0.707, winsorize = FALSE)
